network_status_unavailable: The system does not report whether the Internet is reachable here. Enter a URL for the connection check.
vpn_host_check_platform_unsupported: OpenConnect host-check programs (CSD, HIP, TNCC wrappers) cannot run on Windows. Remove the wrapper path from the profile.
tun_service_missing: TUN on Windows needs the Thronium service, which the installer sets up when Thronium is installed for all users. It is not installed.
tun_service_start_denied: Windows did not allow starting the Thronium service. Reinstall Thronium for all users.
tun_service_unavailable: The Thronium service did not respond. Try again; if it repeats, reinstall Thronium for all users.
tun_service_client_refused: The Thronium service serves only the installed application. This copy runs from another folder.
tun_service_busy: The Thronium service is already running a TUN session for another user or copy of Thronium.
tun_service_external_core_unsupported: External cores cannot be used with TUN on Windows: the service would start them with system rights.
tun_service_write_path_unsupported: With TUN on Windows the configuration may not write a log file, keep its cache outside its own folder or download a dashboard: the service would write them with system rights.
tun_service_worker_failed: The Thronium service could not start its core. Try again; if it repeats, reinstall Thronium.
core_mismatch: ThroniumCore beside the application belongs to another version of Thronium, so it is not started. Reinstall Thronium.
